handback.title: Code groups criteria into stories by shared files
handback.summary: The plan check holds every plan to stories made of criteria that share code files, with no count rules.
handback.user_story: Any ask, however big, splits into stories by the code files its criteria change, never by counting.

acceptance_criteria.text: The plan check rejects a split that puts criteria sharing a code file in different stories.
acceptance_criteria.words: Code groups criteria that share any code file into one story (a sub-issue).

edge_cases.case: Two criteria joined only through a third criterion that shares a file with each.

acceptance_criteria.text: The plan check rejects one story holding criteria with no code file in common.
acceptance_criteria.words: Criteria with no file in common become separate stories.

edge_cases.case: One story of a split holds two criteria on different files.

acceptance_criteria.text: No count of criteria or stories refuses a plan, and the old count rules are gone.
acceptance_criteria.words: No number decides it: no criteria cap, no story cap.

edge_cases.case: A story of a parent splits again because its criteria form two file groups.

acceptance_criteria.text: Two criteria that share only a markdown file stay in separate stories.
acceptance_criteria.words: Markdown files never group criteria and never make a story wait.

edge_cases.case: Two criteria list only the same markdown file and no code file.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each edge case stays under its criterion and never changes how criteria group.
acceptance_criteria.words: Edge cases stay under their criterion and don't affect the split.

edge_cases.case: Edge cases of two unrelated criteria are covered by tests in one test file.

test_changes.tests/test_size_rule.py::test_the_right_: Tested the five-per-story count rule, which this issue removes.
test_changes.tests/test_size_rule.py::test_a_story_ov: Tested refusing stories over five criteria, which this issue removes.
test_changes.tests/test_size_rule.py::test_a_story_of: A story may now split again when its criteria form separate file groups.
test_changes.tests/test_parent_source.py::test_a_crit: A story's split is no longer refused, so it must now pass outright.
test_changes.tests/test_rules_split.py::test_every_te: Skips the three count rule tests this issue drops on purpose.
test_changes.tests/test_criterion_files.py::test_each: Its sample criteria now share a file, so they form one story.
test_changes.tests/test_criterion_files.py::test_a_cr: Its sample criteria now share a file, so they form one story.
test_changes.tests/test_criterion_files.py::test_a_fi: Its sample criteria now share a file, so they form one story.
test_changes.tests/test_plan_shape.py::test_a_feature: Its two sample stories now change different files, as grouping requires.

raises.label: Markdown-only criteria
raises.text: Two criteria changing only the same markdown file become two stories. The plan assumes so, since markdown never groups.
raises.evidence: Issue #661 says markdown files never group criteria; a docs-only ask then splits one story per criterion.
